title: PUBLIC WORKS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to erecting permanent ceremonial signs recognizing the Madrid Theatre, Taxco Theatre, and Canoga Park Youth Arts…
text:
[Council File 26-1242; CD 3]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
PUBLIC WORKS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to erecting permanent ceremonial signs recognizing the Madrid Theatre, Taxco Theatre, and Canoga Park Youth Arts Center in the Canoga Park Arts Hub.
Recommendation for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Blumenfield – Rodriguez):
INSTRUCT the Department of Transportation to erect permanent ceremonial signs, in recognition of their collective contributions to the cultural, artistic, educational, economic, and civic life of Canoga Park and the West Valley, bearing the designations:
"MADRID THEATRE - Canoga Park Arts Hub" at the Madrid Theatre, 21622 Sherman Way.
"TAXCO THEATRE - Canoga Park Arts Hub" at the Taxco Theatre, 7242 Owensmouth Avenue.
"CANOGA PARK YOUTH ARTS CENTER - Canoga Park Arts Hub" at the Canoga Park Youth Arts Center, 7222 Remmet Avenue.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Erecting permanent ceremonial signs recognizing the Madrid Theatre, Taxco Theatre, and Canoga Park Youth Arts Center in the Canoga Park Arts Hub.
